AMGN.headline: Amgen Continues Phase III Clinical Trial for Pegloticase in Uncontrolled Gout
AMGN.summary: Amgen's Phase III clinical trial evaluating subcutaneous and intravenous administration of pegloticase for uncontrolled gout remains active and continues to recruit participants.

AMGN.headline: Steve Jobs' Son Says GLP-1 Weight Loss Drugs Could Be Among Most Important Medicines Ever, With Potential Impact on Cancer
AMGN.summary: Reed Jobs says GLP-1 drugs could help fight cancer; Yosemite fund passes $350M target.

AMGN.headline: FDA Reviews Amgen's Video for VECTIBIX Injection
AMGN.summary: The FDA's Office of Prescription Drug Promotion determined that a submitted video for Amgen's VECTIBIX injection was false or misleading.

AMGN.headline: Amgen Announces Webcast for 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results
AMGN.summary: Amgen has scheduled a webcast to discuss its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.

AMGN.headline: Regeneron and Amgen Narrow Scope of Eylea Biosimilar Lawsuit
AMGN.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals and Amgen have reached an agreement to narrow the scope of their ongoing legal dispute regarding Eylea biosimilars.

AMGN.headline: Amgen Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividend
AMGN.summary: Amgen's Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $2.52 per share.

AMGN.headline: Amgen Announces Upcoming Data Presentations for ACR Convergence 2026
AMGN.summary: Amgen plans to present new clinical data at the American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Convergence 2026, including Phase 3 results for dazodalibep in Sjögren's disease.

AMGN.headline: FDA's Office Of Prescription Drug Promotion Reviews Amgen's Submitted Video For VECTIBIX Injection For Intravenous Use; FDA Determines Video Is False Or Misleading And Breaches Federal Food, Drug, And Cosmetic Act
NORD and Amgen Launch Learning Collaborative for Rare Disease Diagnosis
AMGN.summary: The National Organization for Rare Disorders (NORD) and Amgen have partnered to launch a 14-month pilot program aimed at reducing diagnostic delays for patients with rare autoimmune diseases.

AMGN.headline: Amgen Inc. Appoints David W. Gibbs to Board of Directors
AMGN.summary: Amgen Inc. has appointed David W. Gibbs, the former CEO of Yum! Brands, to its Board of Directors, effective immediately.

AMGN.headline: Amgen, AstraZeneca Drug Combo Shows Promising Survival Results in Tough-To-Treat Lung Cancer
AMGN.summary: Amgen's Imdelltra with Imfinzi cut small-cell lung cancer death risk by 58% in Phase 3, extending median survival to 21.1 months. Read more.

AMGN.headline: Jefferies Adjusts Price Target on Amgen
AMGN.summary: Jefferies has updated its price target for Amgen Inc., increasing it from $410 to $428.

AMGN.headline: Amgen Announced At ESMO Saturday, Phase 3 DeLLphi-305 Data Showing IMDELLTRA + IMFINZI Reduced Death Risk By 58% In First-Line ES-SCLC Maintenance, With Median Overall Survival Of 21.1 Vs. 12.7 Months; One-Year Survival Of Nearly 80% Vs. 53%
